summary: Transform your approach to problem-solving with our Innovation Management and Design Thinking Training. Gain practical skills to innovate effectively.
lede: An innovation training course helps product, service, and transformation professionals turn customer insights into testable concepts. You practise framing opportunities, synthesizing research, prioritizing concepts, prototyping, and testing assumptions to support evidence-based investment decisions. Exercises use the Double Diamond, Lean Startup experiments, and ISO 56002 guidance, and develop an opportunity brief, experiment backlog, prototype test plan, and portfolio recommendation.
audienceIntro: This innovation management course suits professionals who already contribute to product, service, transformation, or organizational change initiatives and need stronger methods for moving from insight to investment decision.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to product development, service improvement, transformation, strategy, research, or innovation projects. Familiarity with cross-functional workshops, customer or stakeholder interviews, and basic business case evaluation will help. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted research, portfolio governance, and ISO 56002 application are taught at an operational application level, not at technical engineering or certification depth.
